core: Intestinal epithelial homeostasis and antimicrobial defense
qualifier: intestinal epithelium development, stem cells and microbiota with defensins
name: Intestinal epithelium homeostasis and defensin antimicrobial defense
rationale: Members combine intestinal epithelial development, structure and stem cell maintenance with alpha/beta defensins and antimicrobial/anti-helminth responses, whereas confusables are generic mucosal antimicrobial peptide themes lacking the intestinal epithelial programme.

name: EGFR and ERBB2 signaling through SHC1 and GRB2 adaptors
rationale: Members are EGFR/ERBB2 (and ERBB4) signaling events via SHC1 and GRB2 plus EGFR transactivation and inhibition, while confusables cover PI3K, PLCG1, GRB7 branches or ERBB3/ERBB4 pairs.

core: RNA polymerase II pausing and elongation
name: Cellular RNA polymerase II pausing and elongation
rationale: All members concern RNA Pol II promoter clearance, promoter-proximal pausing and elongation complex formation in host genes, distinguishing them from HIV/Tat elongation and transcription-initiation confusables.

qualifier: mature, naive and plasma cell surface markers
name: Mature B cell identity and surface signatures
rationale: Members are B lineage identity and surface-marker signatures (naive, memory, plasma, BCR module) with a few lymphocyte-associated sets, whereas confusables emphasise B/T cell development, activation and germinal centre differentiation.

name: NGF-TRKA signaling through PLC-gamma1, STAT3 and retrograde transport
rationale: All members describe NGF activation of TRKA and its PLC-gamma1, STAT3 and retrograde signaling branches, while confusables cover NTRK3, p75NTR, or TRKA ERK5/PI3K/CREB branches.

qualifier: intermembrane lipid transfer and lysophospholipid hydrolysis
name: Intermembrane lipid transfer and phospholipid turnover
rationale: Members span non-vesicular transfer of phospholipids, glycolipids and ceramide-1-phosphate between membranes with PI/sphingomyelin synthesis and lysophospholipid catabolism, unlike confusables centred on membrane traffic, prenylation or bulk PC/PE/cardiolipin synthesis.

name: Congenital disorders of N-glycan assembly and processing
rationale: All members are CDGs from defective ALG/DPAGT1/RFT1/MPDU1 lipid-linked oligosaccharide assembly or MGAT2/B4GALT1 processing, while confusables are CDGs of dolichol and mannose donor precursor synthesis.

qualifier: MHC class I and II induction
name: Type II interferon signaling and MHC induction
rationale: Members are IFN-gamma signaling, its regulation and response including induced MHC class I/II biosynthesis, distinguishing it from type I/III interferon, Th1 differentiation and antigen-presentation confusables.

qualifier: de novo sphingoid and sphingomyelin synthesis and catabolism
name: Sphingolipid de novo biosynthesis and catabolism
rationale: Members cover sphingoid base and sphingomyelin synthesis and sphingolipid breakdown, whereas confusables concern glycosphingolipids, very-long-chain fatty acids, or regulation of ceramide/sphingolipid homeostasis.

name: Excitatory and inhibitory postsynaptic assembly and receptor clustering
rationale: Members cover postsynaptic membrane assembly, PSD-95/NMDA and gephyrin/GABA receptor clustering and regulation of excitatory and inhibitory potentials, while confusables emphasise trans-synaptic adhesion molecules and presynaptic assembly.

qualifier: gut and pituitary peptide hormone GPCR signaling
name: Feeding behavior and gut-pituitary peptide hormone GPCR signaling
rationale: Members combine feeding behavior control with ghrelin, glucagon-family, relaxin and somatostatin receptor signaling and GH/prolactin secretion, distinguishing them from calcitonin/amylin, leptin and fatty acid receptor confusables.

qualifier: enhanced glutamatergic and GABAergic transmission, amygdala
name: Exploratory and motor behavior with enhanced glutamatergic/GABAergic transmission
rationale: Members are locomotor, exploratory, grooming and swimming behaviors with amygdala development and positive regulation of glutamatergic/GABAergic transmission, which confusables of learning, social and sensory behavior lack.

qualifier: glutathione synthesis, NADPH regeneration, aldehyde detoxification
name: Glutathione synthesis, NADPH regeneration and oxidative/aldehyde detoxification
rationale: Members cover glutathione synthesis, recycling, transport and inherited defects with ROS, methylglyoxal and aldehyde detoxification and NADPH supply, unlike confusables on alkylation repair, ascorbate/NAD metabolism or transsulfuration.

name: LTB4 and lipoxin metabolism with eicosanoid omega-oxidation
rationale: Members concern 5-HETE/LTB4 and lipoxin synthesis and their omega-oxidative eicosanoid catabolism, separating them from 12/15-lipoxygenase, resolvin and cysteinyl leukotriene confusables.

qualifier: BAF SWI/SNF complexes and lysine acetylation
name: Protein acetylation and BAF chromatin remodeling complexes
rationale: Members are histone/protein acetylation and BAF/CHD chromatin remodeler assembly, whereas confusables centre on chromatin assembly or histone/protein methylation.

qualifier: receptor internalization, caveolar and pinocytic entry
name: Regulation of receptor internalization, caveolar and pinocytic endocytosis
rationale: Members regulate receptor internalization, caveolin/raft-dependent and pinocytic uptake and early endosome sorting, while confusables concern receptor recycling or lysosomal degradation.

qualifier: RB1-E2F1 control and RB1 mutant defects
name: RB1-E2F1 control of the G1/S checkpoint
rationale: All members concern RB1-E2F binding, RB1 mutant defects, cyclin E:CDK2 phosphorylation and G1/S checkpoint signaling, whereas confusables are E2F target transcription and G2/M programmes.

qualifier: trophoblast giant cells, labyrinth and decidua
name: Trophoblast differentiation, placental labyrinth formation and decidualization
rationale: Members span trophoblast giant/chorionic cell differentiation, labyrinth morphogenesis, chorio-allantoic fusion and decidualization, unlike confusables on early embryo lineages, ovarian cycle or trophoblast migration.

name: Renin-angiotensin and renal regulation of systemic blood pressure
rationale: Members regulate arterial pressure and blood volume via angiotensin, vasopressin, endothelin, vasoconstriction and renal sodium/filtration control, whereas confusables focus on NO-cGMP smooth muscle relaxation or renal water homeostasis.

name: Phosphate-vitamin D homeostasis and hard-tissue mineralization
rationale: Members combine phosphate transport and its disorders, vitamin D metabolism, FGF23-Klotho and PTH responses with bone, dentin and enamel mineralization, unlike vitamin K or odontogenesis/chondrocyte confusables.

name: Embryonic eye morphogenesis with lens and anterior segment development
rationale: Members cover lens, cornea, iris, eyelid, optic cup and embryonic retina morphogenesis, whereas confusables concern retinal neuron/photoreceptor differentiation, optic nerve or post-embryonic eye remodeling.

name: Female meiotic chromosome cohesion and segregation
rationale: Members concern sister chromatid cohesion, chiasmata, spindle assembly, alignment, checkpoints and anaphase control in female meiosis I, unlike confusables on meiotic recombination/synapsis or meiotic entry and polar body extrusion.

name: Neural plate specification, regionalization and border formation
rationale: Members cover anterior/posterior neural plate formation, border specification, neural fold formation and early body patterning, while confusables emphasise neural crest and hindbrain or axial mesoderm and notochord.

name: Aggresome formation and aggrephagy of misfolded proteins
rationale: Members concern misfolded protein responses, perinuclear aggresome assembly and aggrephagy, whereas confusables focus on ERAD, stress granules or chaperone-mediated autophagy.

name: Cardiac conduction system depolarization and electrical coupling
rationale: Members cover SA/AV node and His-Purkinje depolarization, phase 0, HCN channels and gap-junction coupling, while confusables concern repolarization phases, potassium channels or conduction system development.
